images.title: Three ways to travel
images.purpose: Open the chapter with one calm scene of three very different journeys so that students think of their own last trip.
images.composition: Three equal picture panels side by side with thin gaps, left to right: a village road, a market street and a wide busy road. A title banner runs along the top. No numbers anywhere.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Top: a centred title banner reading My Last Journey in large friendly sans-serif text, about 90 px tall. Below it three equal rounded-rectangle panels side by side, each about 440 px wide and 600 px tall, 24 px apart, each with a thin dark outline. Panel 1 (left), village road: a pale dirt road across the lower half; 1 wooden bullock cart with a curved canopy and 2 wheels, pulled by 1 brown bullock with a yoke; 1 villager in a turban walking beside the bullock; 3 leafy green trees in a row behind; a cream sky. Panel 2 (centre), market street: 3 shop fronts in a row along the back, each with an awning and no writing; 1 man in a shirt riding 1 bicycle towards the right in the foreground; 2 small people standing far back on the pavement. Panel 3 (right), wide road seen slightly from above: a grey road with 4 lanes divided by dashed white lines and a low barrier on the right; 12 small cars in assorted flat colours, 3 in each lane, nose to tail, so the road looks full; 3 plain grey tall buildings on the far horizon. No digits, no number plates, no signs with numbers, no dates anywhere.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: People travel in very different ways, and every journey is full of numbers waiting to be counted.
images.description: A scene of three panels: a bullock cart under trees on a village road, a man on a bicycle in a market street, and a wide road full of cars, under the title My Last Journey.
images.context: Concept image of the hook. It redraws the three opening pictures of your maths book as one flat scene. The pictures in your maths book are pencil sketches; here they are simplified and carry no numbers.
images.teaching_notes: Use it while asking about the student's own last long trip: where, how far, how long. Add no distance or count to the picture, because the numbers come from the student's own trip.

image_decisions.why: The hook needs one scene of the three opening journeys so students picture travel before any number appears.
